scope: 50 prior additions plus 132 existing named sprite assets reconciled November 24, 2026
notes: Companion to the original 98 playable vehicles. All cars connect to the same game physics, upgrades, garage, dealership, progression and audio code paths. Pricing is in USD and distinguishes source-supported MSRP, representative market estimates, converted foreign launch values and fictional game values for concepts or one-off prototypes with no public sale. Prices are NOT live VIN-specific appraisals. Some power, dry-weight and historic production figures are trim-level references; see spec_confidence and source URLs. Torque and power inputs for hybrids are effective simplified physics baselines, not separate electric motor simulations. Manufacturer MSRP includes/excludes destination as specified per row; track-only and one-off vehicles often lack comparable used-car markets. November 24 reconciliation: 132 added representative model baselines and illustrative USD values, not independently source-checked. Two unresolved named variants are marked unverified; one unidentified Lotus is recorded in vehicle_asset_exclusions.json pending identification.
